meaning: Each organ must eventually own a red-team side and a blue-team side for its own responsibility zone.
red_team_definition: Find how the organ can fail, lie, leak scope, inflate score, misroute work, confuse an LLM, or accept unsafe evidence.
blue_team_definition: Defend the organ with hard gates, stop conditions, rollback, scope locks, receipts, negative tests, and recovery paths.
top_throne_red_blue_law: Throne red/blue layer must attack fake green, score inflation, stale receipts, self-trust, no-core-mutation lies, and cross-organ proof gaps.
